card.name: Digit 2 inside phone and ISBN numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 2 in the middle of phone numbers and ISBN codes, and sometimes the month 'Feb' in a dated line. It also fires on a doubled j in a name like Surat al-Hajj.

modes.label: Digit 2 in ID numbers
modes.description: The digit 2 partway through a phone number or ISBN.

modes.label: Feb in dates
modes.description: The month abbreviation Feb in a day-month-year date.

card.plain: It marks the digit 2 inside phone numbers and book ID numbers, and sometimes the month Feb in a date.
